'''Nina Kumagaya''' (Japanese: '''熊谷ニーナ''' ''Kumagaya Nina'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She was born on July 18, 1963 in {{wp|Osaka}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|GS}}, voicing recurring character {{an|Casey}}.
